detailed_descriptions.en: Plague Island is a story-driven DLC for the original ATOM RPG that introduces new locations, storylines, characters, and a host of other exciting gameplay features. The plot takes you from a small airfield near Fogelevka to a new world map: an island where a Gwon-Jo-controlled settlement is grappling with a mysterious disease outbreak. KEY FEATURES: Explore the eponymous Plague Island, a new world map featuring thriving and abandoned settlements, mysterious pre-war Soviet installations, challenging pirate forts, lairs of horrendous beasts, and more. Meet 30+ new characters from all walks of life and explore 17 unique locations. Help or hinder them by completing more than a dozen new questlines, some dialogue-driven, others requiring you to fight, or explore the depths of a sealed pre-war bunker. Travel in style: this DLC features airplane flights, submarine rides, and even a new ground vehicle to replace the car you have to leave behind when you set out for the Island. Get your hands on something fans of the original ATOM have been requesting ever since ATOM RPG: Trudograd hit the shelves: your very own suit of Special Armor! And let there be Atom!

The plot takes you from a small airfield near Fogelevka to a new world map: an island where a Gwon-Jo-controlled settlement is grappling with a mysterious disease outbreak.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Meet 30+ new characters from all walks of life and explore 17 unique locations.

  • Help or hinder them by completing more than a dozen new questlines, some dialogue-driven, others requiring you to fight, or explore the depths of a sealed pre-war bunker.

  • Travel in style: this DLC features airplane flights, submarine rides, and even a new ground vehicle to replace the car you have to leave behind when you set out for the Island.

  • Get your hands on something fans of the original ATOM have been requesting ever since ATOM RPG: Trudograd hit the shelves: your very own suit of Special Armor!

And let there be Atom!
